description: Java class defining the LoanRescheduleRequest entity for loan rescheduling in the Fineract project, including fields, constructors, and methods for managing reschedule requests.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequest
classes.description: Entity representing a request to reschedule a loan, including details about the rescheduling, status, and related user actions.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new LoanRescheduleRequest instance with provided parameters.

methods.name: getLoan
methods.description: Returns the associated Loan object.

methods.name: getStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns the current status of the reschedule request.

methods.name: getRescheduleFromInstallment
methods.description: Returns the installment number from which rescheduling starts.

methods.name: getRescheduleFromDate
methods.description: Returns the date from which rescheduling starts.

methods.name: getRescheduleReasonCodeValue
methods.description: Returns the code value representing the reason for rescheduling.

methods.name: getRescheduleReasonComment
methods.description: Returns the comment explaining the reason for rescheduling.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the reschedule request was submitted.

methods.name: getSubmittedByUser
methods.description: Returns the user who submitted the request.

methods.name: getApprovedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the request was approved.

methods.name: getApprovedByUser
methods.description: Returns the user who approved the request.

methods.name: getRejectedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the request was rejected.

methods.name: getRejectedByUser
methods.description: Returns the user who rejected the request.

methods.name: getRecalculateInterest
methods.description: Returns whether interest recalculation is requested.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sets the request status to approved, recording the approver and date.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sets the request status to rejected, recording the rejecter and date.

methods.name: updateLoanRescheduleRequestToTermVariationMappings
methods.description: Adds mappings to the reschedule request.

methods.name: getLoanRescheduleRequestToTermVariationMappings
methods.description: Returns the set of term variation mappings.

methods.name: getInterestRateFromInstallmentTermVariationIfExists
methods.description: Retrieves interest rate variation if present.

methods.name: getDueDateTermVariationIfExists
methods.description: Retrieves due date variation if present.
